summary: All 8 acceptance-matrix criteria exercised: 16 backend pytest cases (7 files) + 8 named browser checks, all passing. One browser check (auth-role-redirects-and-protected-routes) also re-run against the public preview ingress URL to confirm routing works end-to-end.

checks.name: test_tscheck_auth_roles.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/auth/login annapurna->ngo (200), priya->volunteer (200); GET /api/ngo/dashboard as priya->403; anon GET /api/ngo/dashboard->401/403; POST /api/auth/register ngo+volunteer->200; POST /api/auth/register ngo without causes/description->400

checks.name: auth-role-redirects-and-protected-routes
checks.evidence: Login annapurna -> /ngo/dashboard; logout+login priya -> /volunteer/dashboard; direct nav to /ngo/dashboard as volunteer redirected to /volunteer/dashboard; GET /api/ngo/dashboard as volunteer = 403; signed-out nav to /ngo/dashboard -> /login. Also re-ran against public preview URL successfully.

checks.name: register-ngo-and-volunteer-lands-on-profile
checks.evidence: Filled /register/ngo (name/email/phone/location/description/cause chip) -> redirected to /ngo/profile; /register/volunteer -> redirected to /volunteer/profile

checks.name: test_tscheck_event_shift_publish.py
checks.evidence: POST /ngo/events -> draft; POST .../status publish with 0 shifts -> 4xx; 3x POST .../shifts (caps 5/3/8, distinct skills) -> 200; POST shift end<start -> 4xx; POST .../status publish -> 200 published; PUT /ngo/shifts/{id} edit -> 200; DELETE shift & event -> 200; draft event absent from GET /events?q=... for volunteer session

checks.evidence: Created event via form -> draft; clicked Publish with 0 shifts -> blocked (toast/400 in console, event-publish-button still shown); added 3 shifts via Add-shift dialog with different capacity/skill; invalid end<=start shift rejected (dialog stays open); Publish succeeded -> event-unpublish-button visible

checks.name: test_tscheck_discovery_registration.py
checks.evidence: Fresh event/shift(cap1) published -> visible on GET /events?q=; POST /volunteer/registrations -> confirmed, filled=1 on GET /events/{id}; duplicate POST -> 409; second volunteer on full shift -> 409; priya POST registration on overlapping Senior Citizens Health Check-up 09:00-12:00 shift -> 409 'schedule conflict'

checks.evidence: Discover map-view renders; search/category/location/date filters narrow to fixture event; full shift shows disabled 'Full' button; registering on open shift shows registered badge; duplicate POST (API cross-check) -> 409; clicking register on seeded conflicting Senior Citizens shift shows 'Schedule conflict' toast
